text_block_list.text:
With the first three years of running 
through the Twinkle Series alongside 
Vivlos reaching a milestone—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Trainie! Over here, over here~!

Before heading off to my next dream in 
Dubai, we held a celebration to look back 
on these three years. It was a party on a 
cruise ship arranged by the academy.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's waiting over there! I came to 
pick you up, Trainy!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Hey hey, this is super tasty! It's so 
fizzy and refreshing♪"
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll go with that too.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Sure thing!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Have a bite ♡
choice_data_list: …Shall we go see your family first?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Eeeh, you really didn't have to!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Well, oh well!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
While we're here, let's go for a little 
stroll♡

And so, while checking out the interior of 
the ship with Vivlos, we decided to head 
toward where her family was waiting. Just 
then—

text_block_list.name: Ship Passenger A
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos! Congratulations on your wonderful 
performance!

text_block_list.name: Ship Passenger B
text_block_list.text:
You're taking on Dubai? I'll get in touch 
with an acquaintance over there for you. 
Please be sure to rely on them as your 
guide.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, thank you very much♪ I'll do my 
best!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~, I've made so many new 
acquaintances.
choice_data_list: You've turned into quite the celebrity.
You're a total celebrity now, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Hey, I'm so happy~♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna get to know super famous people 
too~, and swap Umastagrams with them~."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I wanna be the kind of girl where people 
think of me whenever they hear 
"celebrity"♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
And then! My family will get tons of 
attention too, right?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Maybe we could do a show like some 
celebrity family~?!
choice_data_list: My dreams are really expanding, huh!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You're acting like it's someone else's 
business, but of course you're 
participating too, Trainy!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Of course! You have to be there for every 
single one!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Because you're my precious, beloved 
Trainer♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —Vivlos! Trainer! Over here!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Okaaay! Coming right now~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You too, Trainie! —Come on, let's go 
together♡
